sources.stateLimit: Year plus at most one of road-user group, sex or age. Joint demographic counts are not supplied. Any n.p. source cell makes its aggregated state value null; suppressed counts are never imputed.
sources.validation: All annual national and sex totals, 2021 age/road-user/state counts, 28 E2 differences, and all E3 2016-2021 shares match the existing CSV charts.
